text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Verxina...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh my. That's a Paka Puchi...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where Verxina was looking,
there was a crane game filled with
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I tried it once before.
When I went to an amusement park with my little sisters.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: The moment Vivlos spotted the Paka Puchi, she made a huge fuss squealing, "So cute!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval didn't say anything out loud, but she kept glancing over in that direction.
choice_data_list: So that's why you decided to try the game.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes. As a reliable big sister, I have to make sure my little sisters are happy.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“Still, with my level of skill it was too difficult...
I feel like I did them a disservice.”
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll catch it right here.
In that case, I'll catch it right here.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. In that case,
may I take you up on that offer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
